description: Free. The company revokes the credential at once (e-CNPJ-signed request). Revocations are listed at /v1/revocations.

ecnpj_signature.description: CMS/PKCS#7 SignedData (detached, base64 DER) of signed_text with the company's e-CNPJ.

signed_text.description: Exactly "KYA Brasil: revoke <credential_id>" followed by a newline and a nonce of your choice.

name: kya_revoke
